answer: Each identity escrows 23 POA for 18 epochs and commits to a raven-tagged funding path. A willow beacon chooses 9 established auditors; 7 replay signed work receipts. Linked member k owes 23*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 23*(2*k-1). The trellis ledger publishes links and samples; failed replay burns all cluster escrows and blocks its keys for 16 epochs.
